about: Built by tools/build_elms.py. The grounds come from OpenStreetMap and the Society’s 1992 sketch map; floors 1, 2 and 3 are traced from the 1994 measured plans in The Elms’ National Historic Landmark nomination, turned so north is up. The basement has no published plan: only its outline is drawn, and the places in it are approximate. The house reopens on November 16, 2026 as “The Elms Experience”, whose route may differ.
source: OpenStreetMap (grounds), The Elms National Historic Landmark nomination (plans of floors 1-3, sketch map of the grounds), the Preservation Society of Newport County’s accessibility page (visitor facilities)
units: grounds: metres x 2.4, north up; house: pixels of the plans x 0.6, turned north up
